Randstad has proudly partnered with a key State Government client to secure a dedicated AO3 Business Support Officer for an immediate 3-month contract based in Cannon Hill. 
 Working in partnership with a prominent State Government department specialising in public infrastructure and trade services, this Brisbane-based opportunity places you right at the heart of essential community programs. Located in Cannon Hill, this full-time 3-month placement is ideal for an organised administrative professional eager to thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. You will play an integral role in supporting operational field staff, tracking program delivery and maintaining excellent customer standards. 
 Your new role 
 Your duties will be tasks including but not limited to… 
 
 
 Coordinating with technical officers to maintain detailed records and process data entries in Ellipse and SAIMS. 
 
 
 Managing outstanding job reports, tracking work order statuses, and assisting with stock control and cost journaling. 
 
 
 Delivering high-quality, professional customer service to internal and external stakeholders and local industry suppliers. 
 
 
 Managing incoming and outgoing correspondence and phone calls within required operational timeframes. 
 
 
 Developing, maintaining, and improving procedural manuals, administrative registers, and general documentation. 
 
 
 Providing proactive administrative support to the broader team and handling escalated inquiries in the absence of senior staff. 
 
 
 What will you need to be successful in this role 
 
 
 Proven experience in a fast-paced administrative environment with a track record of meeting KPIs and performance metrics. 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience using asset/maintenance systems (such as Ellipse or SAIMS) and proficiency in Microsoft Office. 
 
 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills with a focus on exceptional customer service and stakeholder engagement. 
 
 
 High attention to detail and accuracy when inputting data, compiling reports, and maintaining registers. 
 
 
 A positive, team-oriented mindset with the initiative to problem-solve and adapt to recurring work streams. 
 
 
 What You'll Receive 
 
 
 Competitive hourly rate paid weekly. 
 
 
 Convenient work location based on-site in Cannon Hill with local amenities nearby. 
 
 
 Valuable State Government experience expanding your skill set within large-scale operations and asset management systems. 
 
 
 Why work with Randstad? 
 We value our contractors. So in addition to the benefits from your new employer, we can also offer you… 
 
 
 ? A dedicated consultant as a point of contact 
 
 
 ? Discounts at retailers like David Jones, Myer & JB HiFi, Rebel Sport, Woolworths, Hoyts cinemas and many more. 
 
 
 ? A free Employee Assistance Program which will provide you and your family with access to professional support services. 
 
 
 ? Access to your payslips at the click of a button via our MyRandstad App. 
 
 
 ? A weekly pay cycle which gives you access to your wages sooner rather than later. 
 
 
 What now 
 If you meet the criteria and are ready to contribute to an essential government program, please apply today by submitting your updated CV. 
   Note: Unfortunately, due to a high volume of interest in these roles, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.   

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.

Exciting Federal Government Opportunity until the end of the year   
  APS6 Support Needs Assessor  
 50 Federal-government opportunities available across Australia 
   
  Reasons to Apply - At a Glance  
 
 Meaningful, participant-focused work - play a key role in shaping outcomes for people with disabilities through high-quality, person-centred assessments. 
 Join a growing Federal Government agency with a strong focus on operational excellence and career development. 
 Enjoy stability with a hybrid work model, competitive hourly rate, and potential for extension or permanency. 
 
     
  Mandatory requirements:  
 
 Australian Citizenship 
 A recognised tertiary qualification in an allied health or relevant clinical discipline (i.e. Occupational Therapy, Physiotherapy, Social Work, Psychology, Nursing or similar). 
 
   
  Your New Company  
 Your organisation delivers a national support system for Australians living with disability, funding essential services tailored to individual needs and helping people achieve their goals. As a growing Federal Government agency focused on operational excellence, this role offers a chance to contribute to meaningful initiatives and take your career to the next level. 
   
  Your New Role  
 You will be responsible for: 
 
 Conducting comprehensive support needs assessments by engaging with participants and their representatives to gather detailed, accurate information, ensuring a respectful, trauma-informed and person-centred approach throughout the process. 
 Analysing, interpreting and synthesising complex information and external evidence to develop clear, evidence-based assessments that accurately reflect individual circumstances and inform appropriate support outcomes. 
 Preparing high-quality written assessment reports that are clear, consistent and aligned with legislative and policy frameworks, ensuring decisions are transparent, defensible and uphold ethical standards. 
 Communicating effectively with participants, families and stakeholders across a range of channels, explaining assessment processes and outcomes in a way that is accessible, inclusive and easy to understand. 
 
   
   
  What You Will Need to Succeed  
 The successful applicant will demonstrate: 
 
 A recognised tertiary qualification in an allied health or relevant clinical discipline (such as Occupational Therapy, Physiotherapy, Social Work, Psychology, Nursing or similar), is a requirement for the role. 
 Strong assessment capability and background, with the ability to gather, interpret and synthesise complex information to support clear, evidence-based decision-making. 
 Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to convey complex or sensitive information in a clear, respectful and accessible way across diverse audiences. 
 Sound judgement and problem-solving ability, with experience applying policy and managing risk to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes in a complex environment. 
 
   
  The Logistics  
 
 Contract until December 31st, 2026, with a view of extension or permanency. 
 Full-time & Hybrid working arrangement. 
 Hourly rate of $61.86 + super. 
 Australian Citizenship & tertiary qualification (proof required) is mandatory. 
 Opportunities across QLD, including: Brisbane, Chermside, Ipswich, Maroochydore, Mount Gravatt, Robina & Townsville. 
 
   
  What You'll Get in Return  
 
 An opportunity to progress your career with a large Federal Government agency. 
 Work-from-home flexibility and a hot desk office environment. 
 A positive and open working culture. 
 Initial 2-week's training provided (on-site mandatory) 
 Weekly pay cycle. 
 Online timesheet submission and approval. 
 Nominated superannuation fund. 
 
   
  What You Need to Do Now  
 If this role sounds like something you'd be interested in pursuing, click 'Apply Now' or forward your current CV to Tom.James@hays.com.au. Please include a short summary outlining your suitability for the role, along with the location to which you are applying. 
   
 *Due to the high volume of applications we are currently receiving, we may not be able to respond to every email. We appreciate your patience during this busy period* 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.
